acceptanceCriteria: Claim text is indexed in the query index and docs_search ranks claims (or docs_claims accepts query), returning eval-visible claim IDs.
An eval fixture with expect.claims cases reaches nonzero claim recall; the test fails before the change.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1555 (1.0.0-rc.3, main 6e90476). docs corpus eval with 52 labelled cases: path expectations pass 21/24, claim expectations 0/28 (recall 0/53, nothing unresolved). docs_search never returns a claim row even when the query paraphrases a claim; docs_claims takes only path.
title: GH #1555: claim text is not searchable; docs_search ranks only subjects and docs_claims takes only a path
